## Overview

This Adyen Touch'n Go for Web page, last modified 2019-09-30 and captured 2026-09-15, is an integration chooser. It points to Web Drop-in and Components child guides and general Web integration material. It does not itself specify payment fields, API/SDK versions, merchant eligibility, redirect handling or final outcomes. [[adyen]] [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Two Web routes:** The page describes Drop-in as an all-in-one UI option for adding Touch'n Go to a website and Components as a prebuilt Component to render it. The linked child guides, rather than this chooser, define implementation behavior. (raw lines 19–27)
- **General guide links:** It also links general Web Drop-in and Components documentation. The page does not identify a Sessions or Advanced server-side flow, or state a method-specific prerequisite. (raw line 29)
- **Evidence boundary:** The chooser does not establish current MY/MYR eligibility, TEST/LIVE availability, a successful shopper redirect, authorization, capture, settlement or refund. Use the method overview and child guide for separate method-specific claims. (raw lines 15–29)
